# 7425 - Dual 4-input NOR gate with strobe

Package DIP-14 · family 74 · catalogue file [catalog/chips/7425.json](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/RetroSchematic/blob/master/src/catalog/chips/7425.json)

## Symbol

| As printed in ND-13.003.01, page 9 | Drawn in ND style | Drawn in modern style |
|---|---|---|
| ![7425 as printed in the 1976 symbol manual](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/7425.png) | ![7425 drawn in nd style](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/shapes/nor-strobe4.png) | ![7425 drawn in modern style](../../../catalog/symbols/modern/shapes/nor-strobe4.png) |

A tall X box with four inputs, and a fifth input G entering from below the box (strobe).

How to tell it on a drawing: X box with an input from underneath = NOR with strobe.

All symbols: [symbol catalogue](../../SYMBOL-CATALOG.md).

## Pins

| Pin | Name | Role | Active | Output type | Details |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 1A | input |  |  |  |
| 2 | 1B | input |  |  |  |
| 3 | 1G | enable | high |  | controls pins 6; when not enabled: high |
| 4 | 1C | input |  |  |  |
| 5 | 1D | input |  |  |  |
| 6 | 1Y | output |  | totem-pole |  |
| 7 | GND | ground |  |  |  |
| 8 | 2Y | output |  | totem-pole |  |
| 9 | 2A | input |  |  |  |
| 10 | 2B | input |  |  |  |
| 11 | 2G | enable | high |  | controls pins 8; when not enabled: high |
| 12 | 2C | input |  |  |  |
| 13 | 2D | input |  |  |  |
| 14 | VCC | power |  |  | +5 V |

## Functions

| Output pin | Formula | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 6 | 1Y = NOT(1G AND (1A OR 1B OR 1C OR 1D)) | When 1G is high, 1Y is low if any of 1A, 1B, 1C, 1D is high, else high; when 1G is low, 1Y is high. |
| 8 | 2Y = NOT(2G AND (2A OR 2B OR 2C OR 2D)) | When 2G is high, 2Y is low if any of 2A, 2B, 2C, 2D is high, else high; when 2G is low, 2Y is high. |

## Electrical

| Value | Figure |
|---|---|
| outputLowMaxCurrentMa | 16 |
| outputHighMaxCurrentMa | -0.8 |
| inputSchmitt | no |
| notes | Strobe inputs load more than data inputs: IIH 160 uA vs 40 uA, IIL -6.4 mA vs -1.6 mA. |

## Propagation delays

All measured at VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, RL 400 ohm, CL 15 pF.

| From | To | Edge | Typ ns | Max ns |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| any | Y | PLH | 13 | 22 |
| any | Y | PHL | 8 | 15 |

## Notes

The datasheet gives no minimum propagation delay; minNs is null (the path-delay function uses 0 ns). No setup/hold/pulse-width limits apply to a gate, so timingLimits is empty. The switching table covers the '23 and '25 together, measured with fan-out N = 10.

## Sources

- [TI SN5423/SN5425/SN7423/SN7425 datasheet SDLS082](https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/sn7425.pdf) - 1-3; SN7425
